subject: Long-lead GPU commit for Q1 Dedicated onboarding — procurement coordination
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@aethercloud.com>, Evan Chen <evan@pluto.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Long-lead GPU commit for Q1 Dedicated onboarding — procurement coordination

Hi Marta / Evan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We are trying to firm up the procurement path for the Q1 dedicated pool tied to the AC-77 deal. High-level ask:

- Commit: ~1,200 A100-equivalent GPUs (mix of A100-40/80 + fallback SKUs) by end of Q1 2027.
- Primary path: OEM fulfillment (customer-managed racks via Aether OEM channel).
- Backstop: cloud-resident capacity (spot/reserved) for first 6 weeks of onboarding.

Two urgent items we need from Aether to finalize executive approval:

1) A revised OEM quote that includes lead-time windows (manufacturing slot, ship, customs) and a tranche schedule if fulfillment is split across shipments.
2) Confirmation of whether Aether can provide a short-term cloud capacity reservation to cover first 6 weeks (region: eu-west-1) and an approximate hourly rate for a dedicated backstop.

I've attached our dedicated_capacity_estimate_OLGA.xlsx with the expected throughput and acceptance tests to align on sizing. For procurement planning, we need explicit ETA ranges — we are seeing vendor lead times of 18–22 weeks for similar SKUs and need to map contractual milestones to those windows.

Can you respond with the OEM quote and a short note on cloud backstop availability by EOD Wednesday? If procurement needs a deposit schedule, flag that so we can route through Finance.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dedicated_capacity_estimate_OLGA.xlsx (XLSX - 120 KB)]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@aethercloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Chen <evan@pluto.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Long-lead GPU commit for Q1 Dedicated onboarding — procurement coordination

Hi Olga,

Appreciate the clear summary. Attached is an updated OEM quote (aether_oem_quote_v2.pdf) and a short lead-time appendix. Key notes:

- Current manufacturing slot: earliest assembly start week of 2027-02-07, ship window 2027-03-15 — 2027-04-05 depending on supplier queue.
- Customs & logistics: add 2–3 weeks for EU inland transit and customs hold, with variability for port congestion.
- Tranche option: we can split into two deliveries (60% / 40%) spaced 3–4 weeks apart; each tranche requires a partial release and 30% deposit.
- Short-term cloud reservation: we can hold a 6-week reservation in eu-west-1 but it will be on a blended rate; estimate EUR 45–60 / GPU-hour depending on instance class. Exact SKU and capacity must be locked 48 hours before activation.

Open questions for Redwood:
1) Is Redwood comfortable with a 30% deposit per tranche? If not, we can propose a smaller deposit with a longer lead time commitment window.
2) Can you confirm the acceptance tests that must run in the first 6 weeks so we size the cloud backstop appropriately?

We'll hold the slot for 5 business days after your confirmation.

Best,

Marta Ruiz
Head of OEM Sales — Aether Cloud
[Attachment: aether_oem_quote_v2.pdf (PDF - 420 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 07:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Long-lead GPU commit for Q1 Dedicated onboarding — procurement coordination

Olga / Ben,

Thanks for looping me in. Quick operational notes:

- Cloud backstop is the least friction path to keep the rollout moving; Ben, can you run a quick cost calc based on Marta's EUR 45–60/GPU-hour and the attached estimate? We should model 6 weeks at peak onboarding load and an average at 60% utilization.
- On deposit: Finance will accept a tranche deposit up to 25% without board escalation; 30% requires C-level signoff. If Aether insists on 30%, we can try to negotiate a 20% + performance guarantee (letter of credit).
- Legal: request that the OEM quote includes a clear slippage credit (per-week penalties) and a force-majeure carveout limited to specific events.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Olga: request Marta to reduce deposit to 20% or provide an LOC option.
2) Ben: cost calc and runway for cloud backstop by EOD.
3) Lauren: schedule a 30-min procurement/ops handshake with Aether (tomorrow 09:00–10:30 CET slots available).

I'll prep a short internal summary for Finance/legal once we have the revised quote.

Thanks,

Karthik
VP, Dedicated Products
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@aethercloud.com>, Evan Chen <evan@pluto.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Long-lead GPU commit for Q1 Dedicated onboarding — procurement coordination

Thanks, Marta and team — and Karthik for the summary.

Marta: can you confirm whether Aether will accept a 20% deposit + letter of credit (LOC) as an alternative to 30%? If yes we'll proceed to lock the slot. Also please add the slippage credit language and the tranche penalty schedule into the quote appendix so Legal can review quickly.

Proposed meeting: 2026-11-19 09:30 CET / 00:30 PST — 30 minutes to walk the tranche schedule and cloud backstop. Please confirm or propose an alternate; I'll send a calendar invite once we have a time.

Links:
- Internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321
- Draft DocuSign for tranche deposit (will populate once deposit amount is confirmed)

Olga
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
